notes: Customer is a mid-market analytics SaaS (B2B) building an in-app assistant and knowledge search across product docs.
Primary driver: improve in-app conversion and reduce support tickets by surfacing product answers + summaries.
POC scope: hosted API first (chat + semantic search). If thresholds met, move to Dedicated VPC for predictable throughput and data isolation.
Security emphasis: SOC2 attestation, SSO (SAML), audit logs with 1 year retention, ability to route logs to their SIEM, KMS for customer-managed keys.
Quote from Marta (CTO): 'We can start on hosted but we will require a VPC/dedicated environment within 8 weeks if POC meets accuracy and latency goals.'
Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay premium for predictable SLA and VPC isolation but needs clear unit economics for tokens and caching gains.
SE notes: consider recommending a quantized mid-size model for reranking + dedicate L2 cache to reduce token counts. Mention Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and cache TTLs.
They asked about cross-region failover and whether Redwood can do automatic fallbacks to a cheaper model in case of capacity issues.
Procurement will require papering (DPA + addendum) and a short SOC2 review before signing Dedicated contract.
use_case_summary: Workloads: interactive in-app chat assistant (support flow) plus doc search for knowledge base and summarization of long docs.
Latency target: p95 < 300ms for short chat replies; p95 < 500ms for longer summarization tasks. Throughput: ~150 RPS burst, steady 40 RPS.
Accuracy/quality: high priority — they will run evals against their prompt set and expect Redwood Optimize to flag regressions.
Model preferences: open model family OK, but need Redwood-verified perf profiles and quantization options. Want fallback variant for cost control.
Routing/fallback: must support routing to dedicated pool in us-east, fallback to hosted-compatible variant with graceful degradation.
Data handling: customer data must not be used for model training; retention controls + ability to blob logs to their S3/GCS for audits.
requirements: SOC2 Type II evidence or SOC2 report + expected attestation date.
SSO via SAML + SCIM for user provisioning into Redwood Console.
Audit logging with export to customer SIEM (Syslog/S3) and retention configurable to 12 months.
Dedicated VPC peering options, static egress IPs, and firewall rules doc for procurement security team.
KMS integration for customer-managed keys (optional but preferred).
Detailed per-token cost model and estimate for expected workload; sample billing scenarios for caching and batching benefits.
SLA expectations for Dedicated: uptime + latency SLOs spelled out in contract.
